risks.title: Volatility of energy commodity prices
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned at the beginning of the risk factors section (Item 1A) and is characterized as impactful on results and financial position. Volatility in gas, NGL, and crude oil prices is a major and constant concern for the company.

risks.title: Dependence on volumes and customer demand
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes that volumes processed and capacity utilization depend on producer activity, which is itself linked to commodity prices. A decline in producer activity reduces demand for the company's services.

risks.title: Capital access and cost of financing
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions potential limitations on capital access and the impact of elevated cost of capital on growth strategy and acquisition plans. Market volatility can affect sector companies' financing capacity.

risks.title: Contract structure and price exposure
risks.score_rationale: While the company benefits from fee-based contracts, a portion of its revenue (volume participation) is directly exposed to commodity price variations. Contract composition may evolve.

risks.title: Increase in operating expenses
risks.score_rationale: The text indicates that operating expenses, while relatively stable, may increase with asset expansion and inflation. Service, repair, maintenance, and tax costs are noted as significant.

risks.title: Competition for assets and opportunities
risks.score_rationale: The capital markets section mentions that competition for development opportunities and asset acquisitions may limit the company's ability to execute its growth strategy.

ai_positioning.summary: TRGP does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. Remote monitoring systems mentioned are standard operational monitoring systems, not AI systems.
